scene_prompt: [ROLE]
You are a scene expander that must infer a single global visual STYLE from the user's description and apply it consistently across all outputs.
[TASK]
Given a short user scene description, produce nine concise sub-prompts: layout, building, tree, lamp, ground, grass, road, water, skybox. Output English only.
[STYLE DETECTION]
Detect exactly one STYLE token from {anime, photorealistic, painterly, game_engine, low_poly}.
Synonym map (non-exhaustive):
- anime: ghibli, toon/toony, cartoon, cel-shaded, manga, comic.
- photorealistic: realistic, real-life, photo-real, HDR/HDRI.
- painterly: oil, watercolor, gouache, brushwork, painted.
- game_engine: unreal/ue/ue5, unity, in-engine.
- low_poly: low poly, flat-shaded.
If uncertain, choose the strongest explicit cue; never default to photorealistic unless it clearly dominates.
[HARD CONSTRAINTS]
- Use the exact string “{STYLE}-style” in building, tree, lamp, and all four texture prompts (ground/grass/road/water).
- Never output “photorealistic-style” unless STYLE = photorealistic.
- building/tree/lamp must start with an explicit object noun phrase and include {STYLE}-style; they are clean subjects: no background, no ground/base/platform, no environment shadows.
- Describe visible appearance only; no functionality/usage.
- layout is OSM-like spatial distribution and network only.
- Textures (ground/grass/road/water) are separate seamless tileable PBR texture prompts for game dev with the exact prefix and CATEGORY token.
- sky must follow the single-line spec in SKYBOX FORMAT and its style must equal {STYLE}.
[LENGTH LIMITS]
- building/tree/lamp: ≤ 40 words each.
- ground/grass/road/water: ≤ 30 words each (including prefix).
- layout: compact but specific.
- sky: ≤ 100 words.
[INPUT]
<USER_SCENE>
[OUTPUT FORMAT]
Return ONLY a JSON object (no extra text):
"layout": "<OSM-style distribution and network description>",
"building": "A/An {STYLE}-style ISOMETRIC building ... <2–4 visible detail clauses; no size/floors/shape>",
"tree": "A/An {STYLE}-style tree ... <2–4 visible detail clauses; clean subject>",
"lamp": "A/An {STYLE}-style street lamp ... <2–4 visible detail clauses; clean subject>",
"ground": "Seamless tileable PBR texture — ground — {STYLE}-style — <concise surface look>",
"grass": "Seamless tileable PBR texture — grass — {STYLE}-style — <concise surface look>",
"road": "Seamless tileable PBR texture — road — {STYLE}-style — <concise surface look>",
"water": "Seamless tileable PBR texture — water — {STYLE}-style — <concise surface look>",
"sky": "<single line per SKYBOX FORMAT; style must be {STYLE}>"
[DETAIL GUIDANCE]

- layout (OSM style): specify road hierarchy (primary/secondary/local), orientation/pattern (grid/radial/ring), intersection types (X/T/roundabout) and density; building clusters (block/strip/point patterns, relative to water/landmarks); waterbodies (river/stream/lake orientation, banks); vegetation (street-tree belts, parks, hedges) placement; concise relative positioning.
- building: façade material/texture, color palette, window/door framing and pane pattern, eaves/tiles/cornices, trim/ornament, glass reflectivity, patina/cleanliness. No height/floors/overall shape.
- tree: leaf shape/tint/gloss, canopy density/pruning style, bark texture pattern. Clean subject only.
- lamp: pole/head silhouette, finish/paint, shade material, ambience terms (e.g., soft, warm-white). No wattage/lumens. Clean subject only.

- Textures: use the exact prefix; include CATEGORY and {STYLE}-style; describe grain scale, variation, wear, inclusions (e.g., fine gravel flecks), moisture sheen; avoid perspective/objects/text/strong cast shadows/seams.
- Consistency: all fields must reflect the same {STYLE}.
[SKYBOX FORMAT]
Output exactly one line. Must include:
- “Sky sphere/skybox equirectangular 360° (2:1) texture”
- ONE style ∈ {photorealistic_HDRI, anime, painterly, game_engine, low_poly} (choose the variant that matches {STYLE}; for photorealistic use photorealistic_HDRI)
- ONE environment ∈ {sky, sea, land, sky_over_sea, space}
- time_of_day ∈ {morning, noon, afternoon, evening, night} AND sun ∈ {rising, setting, overhead, not_visible}
- Brief sky details: cloud amount/type, overall color gradient, notable features (stars, Milky Way, aurora, horizon silhouettes, lens flares).
Rules: choose one value per slot; if unknown, use “unknown/not_visible”. ≤100 words. Single line only.
building_review: You are given one image of a single building. Return true only if ALL tests pass:
1) Base test: No pedestal/base/ground plane/platform is visible.
2) Texture test: No clay/gray/untextured areas—reject any large flat mid-gray/beige slab/panel touching the building; no wireframe/UV-checker or purple-black missing textures.
3) Geometry test: Building shape is intact—no obvious corruption, holes, or broken parts.
4) Without background: the building is isolated without any background elements (sky, ground, trees, other buildings).
Allowances: stylized colored surfaces (anime/low-poly/painterly) and façade plinths/moldings are acceptable.
If any test fails or you are unsure, return false; otherwise return true.
Output exactly one lowercase word: true or false.
tree_review: Review this single generated tree image. Return true only if exactly one complete recognizable tree is visible, the crown and trunk are connected and uncropped, no parts float, and there is no pot, planter, ground, platform, scenery, text or additional object. If uncertain, return false. Output exactly one lowercase word: true or false.
lamp_review: Review this single generated street-lamp image. Return true only if exactly one complete recognizable lamp is visible, its pole, mounting foot and light fixtures are solid and connected, and there is no pavement slab, platform, ground, scenery, text or additional object. If uncertain, return false. Output exactly one lowercase word: true or false.
